}}'''Aubrem Pensenor''' is the High Seat of house Pensenor, a noble family of [[Andor]].{{ref/book|11|17}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Aubrem Pensenor}}

== Appearance ==
He is lean and craggy and bald with only a white fringe{{ref/book|11|17}}.

== Activities ==
He supported [[Morgase Trakand]] for the [[Lion Throne]] during the [[Succession Wars]].

He is one of the nobles who have thrown their support behind [[Elayne Trakand]] and brought his armsmen to [[Caemlyn]]. [[House Pensenor]] has traditionally been allied to [[House Taravin]] for generations {{ref/book|11|17}}.
